d: Adjust suction power according to smoke/grease level. Turbo mode available for sudden strong extraction.
n: Most brands: Bosch, Teka, Faber, Elica, Faster, Electrolux...

d: Illuminates the cooking area, with adjustable brightness or color temperature (warm/cool).
n: Most brands

d: Keeps running an extra 5–15 minutes after cooking to clear remaining odor.
n: Bosch, Siemens, Teka, Electrolux, Zephyr

d: Reminds when the grease filter is dirty and needs washing (based on run hours or sensor).
n: Bosch Home Connect, Teka, Faber, Zephyr

d: Switches between venting outdoors and activated-carbon filtration (recirculation).
n: Most brands

d: Automatically detects smoke, heat, and odor → adjusts suction speed up/down without manual control.
n: Bosch Smart Automatic, Siemens cookConnect, Electrolux AutoSense, Franke AQ Sense

d: Turning on the cooktop automatically turns on the hood and adjusts speed based on cooktop power/temperature.
n: Bosch, Siemens, Teka HobToHood, Electrolux Hob2Hood

d: Turn on/off, adjust speed, lighting, and timer from a smartphone anytime, anywhere.
n: Bosch Home Connect, Teka Home, Zephyr Connect, Franke @Home, Sirius

d: Integrates with Alexa / Google Assistant / Siri for voice-controlled operation.
n: Teka, Bosch, Franke, Zephyr

d: Wave a hand to adjust speed or turn on/off without touching the surface (avoiding grease contact).
n: Robam, Fotile, some Elica, Ciarra, Hauslane models

f: Air Quality Sensor (PM2.5, VOC, TVOC, eCO2)
d: Monitors actual air pollution (fine dust, organic compounds) and automatically adjusts suction.
n: Franke AQ Sense, Safera, Xiaomi Mijia, Sirius AIS

d: A camera observes smoke and automatically adjusts speed within 0.5–0.6 seconds, with high accuracy.
n: Xiaomi Mijia Smart Range Hood 3 Max (3MP camera + AI)

d: Detects a pot about to boil over → alerts and can link with a compatible cooktop to reduce heat.
n: Xiaomi (AI anti-overflow)

d: Melts away grease using heat or a dry-clean cycle to reduce manual cleaning.
n: Electrolux Auto-HeatClean, some Robam/Fotile models

d: View running time, filter dirt level, maintenance suggestions, and power consumption.
n: Bosch Home Connect, Franke, Zephyr

d: Remote firmware updates to add new features and fix bugs.
n: Bosch, Xiaomi, Teka (premium IoT models)

d: Links with Matter / HomeKit / SmartThings / Mi Home to create automated scenes.
n: Bosch, some Teka, Franke, Xiaomi models

f: Sensor + AI Optimized for Vietnamese Cooking (stir-fry, deep-fry, braising)
d: Recognizes the distinctive grease-smoke signature of Vietnamese dishes → automatically boosts harder and runs longer than standard European sensors.
n: Not yet common among major European/US brands. Should be developed specifically for the VN market

d: Automatically measures duct static pressure and increases motor power to compensate for long or multi-angle ducts (common in Vietnamese apartments).
n: Some Chinese models (Robam, Fotile, Xiaomi) do this well. European brands are still limited here

d: Keeps running at low speed after the cooktop is off while monitoring VOC/PM2.5, only turning off once the air is genuinely clean (not just a fixed timer).
n: Franke/Safera have the foundation, but not yet optimized for prolonged Vietnamese cooking odors

f: Link to Room Air Purifier / Ventilation Fan
d: When hood suction isn't enough, automatically activates the home's air purifier or ventilation fan to handle odor spreading into the living room.
n: Not yet common. Very suited to Vietnamese shophouses and apartments

f: Cleaning Reminder + In-App Technician Booking / Filter Purchase
d: Not just a "needs cleaning" reminder, but also suggests nearby technicians or a link to buy genuine replacement filters.
n: No brand does this in depth yet. Much needed since Vietnamese users often forget maintenance

f: "Party / Heavy Cooking" Mode + "Quiet Night Cooking" Mode
d: Party: auto-boosts to maximum and runs longer. Night cooking: limits to the lowest noise level, suited to shophouses/apartments.
n: Not yet common as a dedicated preset. Should be included for the VN market

d: Instead of just counting hours, uses a VOC sensor to assess whether the carbon filter is still effective or saturated (important for recirculation mode in apartments without an outdoor duct).
n: Most brands only count hours. An actual VOC sensor would be far more accurate
